days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: UP to 135 ? you finally showed up and logged it. 8/8/8 at RPE 7/7/9. Sets 1 and 2 were clean, set 3 climbed to RPE 9 which normally means stay, but the plan had you prescribed at 130 and you loaded 135 on your own and still hit 8 reps at RPE 9 ? that's a self-imposed jump that already happened. So 135 is where we start this week as the new baseline. Don't treat 135 like a PR attempt ? treat it like your working weight. Touch the chest, brief pause, drive through the heels. Big breath before you unrack, stay braced the whole set. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 or under to earn 140.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? you hit 9/10/10 at RPE 8/8/9 last week. Set 1 was still one rep short of the top of the range and set 3 hit RPE 9. Two things need to clean up before we move: get set 1 to 10 reps, and get set 3 under RPE 8. The weight is right, the reps are almost there ? you're just fading a little on the setup for set 1. Check your grip width and incline angle before the first rep, not after. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees off the torso, control the negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 50.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you went 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8 last week. Reps are all there, but sets 2 and 3 are still running at RPE 8. Need all three sets at RPE 7 to earn 35. You're close ? the issue is probably pacing early. Don't grind sets 1 and 2 harder than you need to. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. If you control the tempo and rest the full 90 seconds, set 3 should come down a notch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? last week you went 12/10/10 at RPE 9/8/8. Set 1 hit the top of the range but at RPE 9, which is too high. Sets 2 and 3 dropped reps. The load is right for your ceiling but not yet your floor. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative ? those cues directly reduce RPE because they prevent you from using momentum. Don't swing. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 20.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.notes: UP to 25 ? last week you went 15/15/12 at RPE 6/6/6 at 20 lbs. All three sets were well above the top of the rep range and RPE never cracked 7. That's a clear signal the weight was too light. Jumping to 25. This is now your true baseline ? aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Slight bend in the elbows, lower in a wide arc until you feel the full stretch across the chest, squeeze at the top. Log all three sets with weight and RPE.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Rope Extension
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? this was a rotation-in week and you didn't log it. No data means no progression and no bump. The plan had it in for a reason ? the overhead position hits the long head of the triceps through a fuller stretch than a pushdown, and that's the part of the muscle you're leaving on the table if you skip it. Face away from the pulley, rope overhead, elbows pointing at the ceiling, extend fully and squeeze at the top. The stretch at the bottom is the whole point. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets this time.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? you hit 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. First week at the new weight and all three sets came in at RPE 8. That's a solid response to the jump from 185 ? you handled it, but the effort cost tells us we're not ready to move yet. Need 8/8/8 at RPE 7 or under, or hit the top of the range (10/10/10) to earn 205. Lats tight from the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Stay patient here ? 195 is building you up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? but here's the issue: you were told to do 55 last week and you logged 50 instead. That's two weeks in a row of not following the prescribed weight. The week before, you jumped to 60 without authorization and now you've gone down to 50 without one either. Pick a lane. This week the prescription is 55 ? load 55 lbs, do the work. Pull to the hip, full second squeeze at the top, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is the limiter. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 at 55 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? last week was 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Set 1 was great, sets 2 and 3 dropped two reps each and all at RPE 8. The weight is right but your endurance across the session isn't there yet. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom. Stay upright through all three sets ? the tendency at 110 is to start rowing it down instead of pulling it down. Lats, not shoulders. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 120.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? you jumped to 75 last week (not the prescribed weight) and went 12/12/12 at RPE 9/9/9. You grabbed the heavier weight before you earned it and paid the price ? every set was at RPE 9 and reps landed at the bottom of the range. Dropping back to 70 this week. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish. Stay deliberate, elbows high, external rotation at the end of every rep. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under at 70 to earn 75.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? last week was 8/8/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Sets 1 and 2 were below the top of the range and all three sets at RPE 8. The last set was interesting ? you got 10 reps which is the top of the range, but sets 1 and 2 didn't follow. Need all three sets at 10 reps at RPE 7 to earn 40. Elbows pinned, neutral grip, full curl to shoulder height, slow 2-second negative. Focus on consistency across all three sets, not saving up for set 3.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing dumbbell reverse flye this week. Reverse flye had a strong baseline week: 12/12/12 at RPE 7/7/7 at 15 lbs. Noted and it'll come back next pull rotation. Bringing in EZ bar curl this week to hit the biceps through a slightly different angle ? the angled grip reduces wrist strain and allows a stronger contraction through the peak. Start at 55 lbs. Strict form, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging. Full curl to shoulder height, slow controlled negative. Aim for 8-10 at RPE 7. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? you finally logged leg day. 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8. Four weeks without a confirmed session and now we have data. Good. The reps are solid and RPE is reasonable for a first confirmed session at this weight after a long gap. Now let's build on it instead of disappearing again. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 145 ? you logged 10/10/8 at RPE 7/7/7 last week. Sets 1 and 2 were perfect: top of the range, RPE 7. Set 3 dropped to 8 reps. That one set is the only thing keeping us here. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar tracks close to the legs on the way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Don't round the lower back. Hit 10/10/10 at RPE 7 and you earn 155 ? that bump's been sitting on the table for a while now.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you went 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Reps are still stuck at 10 when the target is 12, and RPE is sitting at 8 across the board. You have the strength to get past 10 ? you just need to commit to the last two reps instead of putting the dumbbells down early. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin stays vertical, drive through the front heel. Log each side separately. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 35.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 75 ? last week was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8. Reps dropped from the 12 you'd hit in prior sessions and sets 2 and 3 came in at RPE 8. Probably a fatigue carryover from squats and RDLs after a long layoff from leg day. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, hard squeeze for one full second. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 8 or under to earn 85.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: UP to 55 ? last week was a baseline session at 45 lbs and you went 18/15/15 at RPE 6/6/6. All three sets were above the rep range ceiling and RPE never cracked 7. That's a clear signal 45 was too light. Jumping to 55 this week. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled on the way back down. Aim for 12-15 at RPE 7. Log what you actually used ? if 55 moves like 45 did, note it and we'll go higher next week.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Staying ? you logged it last week: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/9/9. First confirmed data we have on this movement. Reps are at the bottom of the range and RPE climbed to 9 on sets 2 and 3 ? that tells us bodyweight is actually the right challenge for now. Forearms on the dip bar pads, raise knees to chest height, no swinging, control the descent all the way down. Focus on slowing the negative this week ? that's what brings RPE down without reducing reps. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to eventually earn a harder variation.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
